sanskrit: yad adaḥ saṃprayatīr ahāvanadatā hate | tasmād ā nadyo nāma stha tā vo nāmāni sindhavaḥ ||
english: Because, rushing forward, you cried out and roared as you struck — therefore you are called rivers (nadyaḥ); those are your names, O Sindhus.

sanskrit: yat preṣitā varuṇena- -āc chībhaṃ samavalgata | tad āpnod indro vo yatīs tasmād āpo anu ṣṭhana ||
english: Because, sent forth by Varuṇa, you leapt swiftly together toward the goal — Indra attained you as you strove; therefore, O Waters, follow his ordinance.

sanskrit: apakāmaṃ syandamānā avīvarata vo hikam | indro vaḥ śaktibhir devīs tasmād vār ṇāma vo hikam ||
english: Flowing according to desire, he caused your hiccup to cease; Indra, O divine ones, held you back with his powers — therefore your name for the hiccup is vār (water).

sanskrit: eko vo deva upātiṣṭhat syandamānā upetya | udāniṣur mahīr iti tasmād udakam ucyadhve ||
english: One god came near to you as you flowed, drawing close; the great ones roared upward — therefore you are called udaka (water, the upward-roarer).

sanskrit: āpo devīr ghṛtam id āpa āhur agnīṣomau bibhraty āpa it tāḥ | tīvro raso madhupṛcām araṅgama ā mā prāṇena saha varcasāgan ||
english: The divine Waters — it is ghee, the Waters declare; they carry Agni and Soma, those very Waters. The sharp sap of the honey-mixers has come to meet me; may it come to me together with vital breath and vital lustre.

sanskrit: ād it paśyāmy uta vā śṛṇomy ā mā ghoṣo gacchati vāṅ māsām | mene bhejāno amṛtasya tarhi hiraṇyavarṇā atṛpaṃ yadāpaḥ ||
english: Even now I see, or else I hear — the roar comes to me, the voice reaches my mouth. Having partaken, I deemed myself at that moment sharing in immortality, when the golden-hued Waters came and I was not yet sated.

sanskrit: agnir no dūtaḥ praty etu śatrūn pratidahann abhiśastim arātim | sa cittāni mohayatu pareṣāṃ nihastāṃś ca kṛṇavaj jātavedāḥ ||
english: May Agni, our messenger, go forth against our foes, burning back their curses and their malice; may he confound the minds of our adversaries and render them weaponless — Jātavedas, the Knower of creatures.

sanskrit: ayam agnir amūmuhad yāni cittāni vo hṛdi | vi vo dhamāty okasaḥ pra vo dhamāti sarvataḥ ||
english: This Agni has bewildered all the thoughts that are in your hearts; he blows you away from your dwelling, he blows you forth from every side.

sanskrit: indra cittāni mohaya- -arvāg ākūtyā adhi | agner vātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya ||
english: O Indra, confound their minds — draw their very intent hither; with the rushing blast of Agni and of Wind scatter them in all directions and destroy them.

sanskrit: vy eṣām ākūtaya ita- -atho cittāni muhyata | atho yad adyaiṣāṃ hṛdi tad eṣāṃ pari nir jahi ||
english: Let their intentions scatter hence, and let their minds be bewildered; and whatever is today within their hearts — that, strike out and expel from them utterly.

sanskrit: amīṣāṃ cittāni pratimohayantī gṛhāṇāṅgāny apve parehi | abhi prehi nir daha hṛtsu śokair grāhyāmitrāṃs tamasā vidhya śatrūn ||
english: Seizing their minds in utter bewilderment, O Apvā, go forth and grasp their limbs; advance, burn them inwardly with grief in their hearts, pierce our foes — those enemies fit to be seized — with darkness.

sanskrit: asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣām asmān abhy aity ojasā spardhamānā | tāṃ guhata tamasāpavratena yathaiṣām anyo anyaṃ na jānāt ||
english: That army yonder of our adversaries, O Maruts, which advances against us contending with its might — hide it away with darkness and by the hostile rite, so that not one of them may know another.

sanskrit: agnir no vidvān praty etu śatrūn pratidahann abhiśastim arātim | sa senāṃ mohayatu pareṣāṃ nihastāṃś ca kṛṇavaj jātavedāḥ ||
english: May Agni the Omniscient go forth against our foes, burning back their curses and their malice; may he confound the army of our adversaries and render them weaponless — Jātavedas, the Knower of creatures.

sanskrit: yūyam ugrā maruta īdṛśe stha- -abhi preta mṛḍata sahadhvam | amīmṛḍan vasavo nāthitebhyo +'gnir hy eṣāṃ vidvān praty etu śatrūn ||
english: You are fierce for such a deed, O Maruts — advance, show mercy, prevail together; the Vasus have shown mercy to those who sought their aid. For Agni, knowing all, shall go forth against their foes.

sanskrit: amitrasenāṃ maghavann asmāñ chatrūyatām abhi | yuvaṃ tān indra vṛtrahann agniś ca dahataṃ prati ||
english: O Maghavan, against the hostile army of those who make themselves our enemies — both of you, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, and Agni, burn them back in retaliation.

sanskrit: prasūta indraḥ pravatā haribhyāṃ pra te vajraḥ pra mṛṇann etu śatrūn | jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viśvaṃ hi riṣṭaṃ kṛṇuhi satyam eṣām ||
english: Urged forward, Indra with his two tawny steeds goes downhill; your thunderbolt goes forth crushing the foes; strike those who face you, those alongside, those who flee — make all destruction a truth and reality for them.

sanskrit: senāmohanaṃ kṛṇv indrāmitrebhyas tvam | agner vātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya ||
english: O Indra, bring about confusion of the army against our foes; with the rushing blast of Agni and of Wind scatter them in all directions and destroy them.

sanskrit: indraḥ senāṃ mohayatu maruto ghnantv ojasā | cakṣūṃṣy agnir ā dattāṃ punar etu parājitām ||
english: May Indra confound their army; may the Maruts strike them down with might; may Agni seize their eyes — may the enemy host return defeated.
